messages:
Alex: @here quick poll — we brought a new fiddle-leaf fig into the lounge this morning. Need a name! Drop a vote (number) or suggest your own. Options:
1) Fernie
2) Chonk
3) Photosynth
4) LadyLeaf

Maria: 2 all the way :heart_eyes:

Devon: 3 feels delightfully nerdy :grin:

Sam: 2. also adding 'Mr. Fiddle' as an honorary write-in

Alex: tally so far — 2: Maria, Sam; 3: Devon

OpsBot: Friendly reminder — anyone not on the plant rota, please don't water the office ficus. :seedling: (See #office-policies)

Maria: also +1 for Mr. Fiddle if that's on the table

Devon: officially nominating 'Chonk' because it's a chunky boy :tada:

Alex: love it. Closing informal vote in ~10min (2pm PT). If tie, winner decided by whoever brings snacks tomorrow :eyes:

Sam: I volunteer to break ties. Cupcakes as bribe accepted :cupcake: :wink:

Alex: okay final quick count before closing: 2 (Chonk): Maria, Sam; 3 (Photosynth): Devon; write-ins: Mr. Fiddle (Sam)

Maria: can we put a tiny name tag on the pot? :smile:

Devon: yes please, and maybe a tiny hat next week for his debut :party_popper:

OpsBot: Poll closed by Alex (auto note). Winner: Chonk (by popular demand) — please update the plant roster if you sign up for watering duties.
